title: pretty ELISE|Plus Size Short Sleeve Ruffled V-Neck A-Line Lace Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a sophisticated statement by wearing this plus size all-over lace simple wedding guest dress. Short, sheer lace sleeves and a v-neck give way to a cinched waist and A-line floor-length silhouette. Finish your look with heels, flats, and jewelry. A ruffle on the front adds a luxurious detail with vintage inspiration.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "No Bra" option, with lining.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.


Length: Floor-Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.



Fabric: The garment comprises lace.


Occasion: Mother of the bride dress, Formal evening dress, Mother of the bride dress, Bridal dress, Mature formal dress, Premiere, Banquet.
